messages:
aina: heads up: deploy-bot failed publishing the candidate image for tonight's window. error mentions both tag immutability and kms key mismatch.

deploy-bot: automated: publish failed -> AWS ECR 409 tag-immutability-violation; also 400 KMS:DecryptionFailure for cross-account put. repo `redwood/services/payment` attempted tag `rc-2026-03-21`, digest `sha256:aa11ff...33`.

tom: wait, cross-account? Did the build account change the repo target?

aina: CI writes to our internal CI repo `ci-redwood/services/payment`. deploy-bot then tried to replicate to the shared `redwood/services/payment` (org account) for staging. The org repo has immutability on and only allows KMS key X for signing; deploybot used the builder's encryption context.

lucy: short-term: we can either (A) ask infra to add the builder key as an allowed signer (slow), (B) replicate artifact by pulling by digest into the org account and push with the correct KMS key, or (C) pin the staging deployment to the CI repo digest and skip org push for now.

ops-bot: policy: cross-account pushes must use org KMS key. Automatic fallback to digest-pin allowed for staging only with approver tag.

tom: what's the impact on the release window? We have a production change window at 21:00 UTC (in ~3h). If we choose (B) it may add 30-45min. (C) would be fastest but then production will still require org repo artifact.

aina: my vote is C now for staging so QA can finish. Meanwhile I'll coordinate B as a gated manual step for prod promotion. We should avoid rolling back unless canary fails.

lucy: agree. I'll do a manual pull/push to org repo if QA signs off. Command I'll run: 
```
# from infra-ops account
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name ci-redwood/services/payment --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:aa11ff...33 --registry-id 111111111111 \
  | jq -r .images[0].imageManifest > /tmp/manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/services/payment --image-tag rc-2026-03-21 --image-manifest file:///tmp/manifest.json --registry-id 222222222222 --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...
```

deploy-bot: note: when put-image is used directly with a manifest, cosign attestations are not auto-transferred. You will need to re-sign or attach attestation blob.

ops-bot: approver required for staging digest-pin: please react with :white_check_mark: to approve.

release-coordinator: QA, can you confirm you can test against the CI-repo digest? We need a fast smoke.

qa-bot: smoke tests queued against digest sha256:aa11ff...33. ETA 7m.

tom: approved for staging pin. ops-bot, set flag `staging_digest_pin=sha256:aa11ff...33`.

ops-bot: flag set. Automatic prod promotions still blocked until org repo artifact and KMS signature validated.

aina: added an item to release notes: "Payment service: rc-2026-03-21 promoted to staging pinned by digest due to cross-account KMS policy; manual org push and attestation pending for prod promotion."

lucy: quick reminder: when we push to org repo, reattach cosign attestation with `cosign attach` and validate `cosign verify-blob`.

qa-bot: smoke passed (5/5). QA signs off for staging.

release-coordinator: okay — lucy, please proceed with manual republish to org repo using the manifest+KMS and reattach attestation. If you finish within 60m we keep the 21:00 window. If not, we slide to next slot.

lucy: starting manual republish now. Will update here.

deploy-bot: reminder: avoid attempting automatic promotion again until `deploybot_xaccount_fix` is merged.

aina: opening follow-up ticket: "deploy-bot: support org KMS context + transfer attestation for cross-account swaps" and linking PR.

lucy: republish complete. attestation reattached and cosign verify-blob OK. pushed tag rc-2026-03-21 in org account.

ops-bot: prod promotions flag updated: `prod_release_ok=true` for this artifact.

release-coordinator: excellent. keystone checklist: (1) prod manifest updated to imageDigest sha256:aa11ff...33, (2) dry-run apply to prod-canary -> pass, (3) canary 5%->50%->100% as per rollout plan. I'll kick off at 20:25 to give 35m of pre-window validation.

tom: will monitor metrics and rollback criteria. If any error rate spike >1% in 5m, immediate rollback to previous digest.

aina: thanks everyone. follow-up ticket created and I'll add a note to the release notes about the KMS cross-account caveat.
